entries.title: 正面自然站
entries.body_action: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart, weight evenly shared and knees relaxed. Keep shoulders and pelvis level.
entries.hands: Both hands hang just outside the side seams.
entries.support: Both feet planted; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 避免多个无区别站姿；不用于必须明显动态的画面。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 轻移重心
entries.body_action: Place weight on the left rear leg; the right foot rests slightly forward. Keep rib cage upright with a small pelvic shift.
entries.hands: Both hands hang low, separated from the waist.
entries.support: Left leg bears weight; both feet contact the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 正面左右对称结构照优先正立。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 肩胯轻反转
entries.body_action: Left rear leg bears weight and right foot relaxes forward. Angle pelvis three-quarter toward camera with a modest opposing shoulder rotation.
entries.hands: Hands stay separately at the sides.
entries.support: Both feet on the floor, weight mainly on the left leg.
entries.avoid_when: 需要左右对称或没有前侧商品依据时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 肩胯轻反转·正视
entries.body_action: Left rear leg bears weight and right foot relaxes forward. Seen from the front, retain modest pelvic yaw with opposing shoulder rotation.
entries.hands: Hands stay separately at the sides.
entries.support: Both feet on the floor, weight mainly on the left leg.
entries.avoid_when: 正视图仍包含躯干转向，需前侧商品依据。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 小步停驻
entries.body_action: Pause in a compact step with left foot planted and right heel lightly lifted behind; use a short stride and restrained shoulder and hip counter-swing.
entries.hands: Both arms swing gently below the waist.
entries.support: Left foot planted; right forefoot touches the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 活动量未知或限制步幅时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 小步停驻·背视
entries.body_action: Seen from behind, pause in a compact step with left foot planted and right heel lightly lifted; keep the stride short.
entries.hands: Both arms swing gently below the waist without covering the back.
entries.support: Left foot planted; right forefoot touches the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 需同款背图；活动量未知或限制步幅时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 宽距稳站
entries.body_action: Set feet a little wider than hip width, evenly planted; shoulders and pelvis face camera, torso upright and knees relaxed.
entries.hands: Both hands relax outside the thighs.
entries.support: Both feet bear weight on the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 窄裙、短裙、活动量未知裙装或限制步幅时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 单手腰侧
entries.body_action: Stand mainly on the left leg with right foot lightly to the side-front; use a small opposing shoulder and pelvic tilt.
entries.hands: Left hand rests lightly at the left waist, elbow outward; right hand hangs beside the thigh.
entries.support: Left leg bears weight; right foot touches the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 腰侧口袋或饰带需无遮挡时不用；不压出不存在的收腰。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 错脚肩倚
entries.body_action: Right shoulder lightly contacts a vertical wall; feet are staggered and grounded, pelvis slightly clear of the wall, with a small torso lean.
entries.hands: Both hands hang low; neither hand bears weight.
entries.support: Right shoulder contacts the wall; both feet stay grounded.
entries.avoid_when: 支撑不得切进衣服轮廓；没有可用墙面或前侧商品依据时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 端坐留空
entries.body_action: Sit centrally on a plain flat bench, pelvis fully supported, shoulders over hips, feet flat and knees comfortably separated.
entries.hands: Hands rest on bench edges outside the hips, leaving the garment front clear.
entries.support: Bench supports the pelvis; both feet reach the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 短裙、超短下摆、硬裙撑、活动量不明或必须完整背长时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 轻触领缘
entries.body_action: Keep torso upright, shoulders low and right elbow gently bent.
entries.hands: Right fingertips lightly touch the actual collar outer edge; left hand hangs down.
entries.support: Both feet grounded; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 无领商品或领口必须完全无遮挡时不用；不拉扯领型。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 低位理袖
entries.body_action: Keep chest steady and left forearm low, diagonally beside the body; bend the right elbow without raising either arm across the chest.
entries.hands: Right fingertips lightly touch the actual left wrist cuff; keep both hands away from the torso front.
entries.support: Both feet grounded; neither hand bears weight.
entries.avoid_when: 无袖短袖或袖口需完全无遮挡时不用；不改变袖长结构。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 耳侧轻触
entries.body_action: Stand upright with shoulders and pelvis nearly aligned; bend the right elbow, with only a slight head tilt toward that hand.
entries.hands: Right fingertips reach just behind the right ear; left arm hangs low.
entries.support: Both feet grounded; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 袖部活动不足或耳侧大配饰冲突时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 下颌侧轻触
entries.body_action: Keep shoulders and pelvis balanced; right elbow bends clear of the chest with a small head tilt toward the fingers.
entries.hands: Right fingertips touch beside the right jaw edge without cupping the chin; left arm hangs down.
entries.support: Both feet grounded; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 不露脸裁切或手遮住领口重点时不用。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 背面稳站
entries.body_action: Stand with back facing camera, shoulders and pelvis aligned, feet evenly planted and head neutral.
entries.hands: Arms hang clear of the back silhouette, rear pockets and hem.
entries.support: Both feet planted; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 无同款背图时不用；露脸另核人物角度。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 背斜自然回身
entries.body_action: Show the back in a three-quarter view with pelvis and knees stable; turn shoulders modestly toward one side while weight stays on the rear support leg.
entries.hands: Both arms hang down and clear the garment back.
entries.support: Both feet on the floor; rear leg bears most weight.
entries.avoid_when: 需同款背面与前侧依据；真人新脸角度不得由此图推导。
entries.review_note: Owned AI pose asset reviewed for body geometry; shading and margins may deviate. Use body geometry only; no garment-effect claim.

entries.title: 双肘展开抱头
entries.body_action: Stand with feet slightly staggered and stable. Lift both arms beside the head with elbows opened outward; keep ribs settled and pelvis neutral. Both hands rest lightly behind the upper head, fingers separate and relaxed.
entries.hands: 双手轻搭后脑上缘，手指不交缠
entries.support: Both feet planted, slightly staggered; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 紧窄袖、固定肩带、易走光或必须保持衣长平直的商品
entries.review_note: 沿用试点几何可用判断，未新增独立复核。 顶边余量较小；灰面阴影较重，胸腰形体较具体；首版风格需统一，但不妨碍本次动作参考测试。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 高台边缘半坐
entries.body_action: Perch with only the left sitting bone supported on a narrow ledge. The right leg reaches down and bears weight through a fully planted foot; the left knee bends naturally; do not require this relaxed foot to bear weight or force both feet into the same planted stance. Keep shoulders open. Both hands brace lightly on the ledge beside the hips; show the contact and grounded foot clearly.
entries.hands: 双手在胯旁台沿轻撑
entries.support: Left sitting bone on a narrow ledge, right foot fully planted; both hands lightly brace on the ledge. The bent left leg is relaxed, not weight-bearing.
entries.avoid_when: 台高不合理、脚悬空、短裙、衣摆主结构被坐压；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角
entries.review_note: 既有独立复核：动作几何可参考；不代表全部规格通过。 头顶留白小于8%安全边距；灰色填充有明显体积渐变，风格边距另行复核，不影响本次动作核心。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 侧折腿坐地
entries.body_action: Sit on the floor with both legs folded naturally toward the left. Put most weight on the right sitting bone; lengthen the chest upward with a slight chest-pelvis turn. The right palm supports on the floor behind the right hip; the left hand rests lightly outside the left knee.
entries.hands: 一手撑在侧后地面，另一手轻落膝外
entries.support: Right sitting bone and right palm on the floor; folded legs rest on the ground.
entries.avoid_when: 短裙、膝踝扭转不自然、硬挺礼服结构易塌；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角
entries.review_note: 沿用试点几何可用判断，未新增独立复核。 姿态可用于A/B；灰面仍偏立体渲染，人台腰部较纤细，是否作为最终库画风待Owner判断。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 错位低蹲触地
entries.body_action: Hold a low squat with both feet flat and slightly staggered, left foot forward and right foot back. Knees follow the toes; keep the pelvis low between the feet and the spine long with the chest gently lifted.
entries.hands: Right fingertips and palm touch the floor just outside the right foot; left hand rests outside the left knee.
entries.support: Both feet fully planted; right fingertips and palm touch the floor as secondary support.
entries.avoid_when: 仅沿用试点判断；裙装、紧裤、活动余量未知或需要展示完整裤长时不用；需同款前侧商品依据
entries.review_note: 沿用试点几何可用判断，未新增独立复核。 两脚错位幅度较小；触地手以前掌/手指为主。分块关节线比前三图多，最终画风需统一。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 轻交踝收臂站
entries.body_action: Balance mainly on the left leg and lightly cross the right foot at the ankles in front. Relax neck and shoulders; keep the chest neutral rather than leaning back. Both arms reach behind the waist and hands meet loosely without squeezing the shoulder blades.
entries.hands: 双手在腰后轻接，不夹紧肩胛
entries.support: Left foot supports the stance; the right foot lightly crosses at the ankle with ground contact.
entries.avoid_when: 裤腿完整轮廓或背部结构是重点；脚部不稳
entries.review_note: 既有独立复核：动作几何可参考；不代表全部规格通过。 灰面渐变和关节分块较明显，头顶边距约4%，需按正式图库风格边距另核。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 高低台阶驻足
entries.body_action: Place the left foot on a low, simple step and the right foot on the floor, with most weight through the lower right foot. Keep pelvis rotation modest and shoulders level. Arms stay low; only the left hand may lightly touch a minimal rail at the side.
entries.hands: 手在身体两侧或低位轻触扶栏
entries.support: Right foot on the lower floor bears weight; left foot on a low step, left hand lightly touching a side rail.
entries.avoid_when: 窄裙、长拖尾、足部支撑不可见或不可信；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.body_action: Keep weight centered between both feet. Extend the right arm diagonally upward with a natural open hand; let the left arm hang low. Add only a small side lengthening through the torso, without lifting the hem through an exaggerated arch.

entries.body_action: Show a true side-on crossing step moving horizontally across the image in the direction the chest faces, not side-stepping toward its anatomical left: legs separated enough to read front and rear, with natural opposing shoulder and pelvis rotation. One arm swings forward and the other backward, both below the chest; do not turn the torso into a front-facing pose.
entries.hands: 一臂前摆、一臂后摆，均不过胸前
entries.support: Forward foot planted, rear forefoot touching the floor with heel raised.
entries.avoid_when: 必须正面看清全部门襟；侧向商品依据不足；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 斜线大步
entries.body_action: Take a long but controlled diagonal step with the left foot forward and weight near that foot; the right leg extends naturally behind. Keep torso stable and let both arms swing beside the body without crossing the abdomen.
entries.hands: 双手随步摆在身侧，肘不遮腹部
entries.support: Left forward foot supports the step; right rear forefoot contacts the floor.
entries.avoid_when: 窄裙、拖尾或活动余量未知；不用于证明静态衣长；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 缓步下阶
entries.body_action: Pause during a small descent with the left foot fully planted on the upper step and bearing most weight. Reach the right forefoot lightly to the lower step with the heel raised. Keep the torso upright with a slight shoulder-pelvis turn.
entries.hands: 一手低位扶栏，另一手自然垂摆
entries.support: Left foot fully planted on the upper step bears weight; right forefoot lightly touches the lower step, heel lifted; right hand low on a side rail.
entries.avoid_when: 拖地长裙、鞋底支撑不清楚、栏杆挡住主商品；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 侧持物行走
entries.body_action: Show a small forward step, weight transitioning onto the left foot. Keep the right carrying-side shoulder quiet and the left arm naturally swinging. The right hand forms a relaxed empty carrying grip outside the thigh; add no object. Pelvis turns only slightly.
entries.hands: 一手在大腿外侧虚握，另一手摆动；道具由当次方案决定
entries.support: Weight transfers onto the left forward foot; right rear forefoot remains in contact.
entries.avoid_when: 本件鞋包或侧部细节会被遮挡；不凭线稿给商品加配件；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 交踝门侧倚
entries.body_action: Rest the right shoulder lightly against a minimal vertical doorway edge. Keep the left leg straight as support and cross the right foot lightly in front at the ankle. Preserve a small shoulder-pelvis offset without collapsing the waist; arms remain low, hands outside the legs.
entries.hands: 近手放腿外，远手不插不存在的口袋
entries.support: Right shoulder lightly touches a doorway edge; left leg bears weight and right forefoot lightly crosses in front.
entries.avoid_when: 裤腿宽度展示、窄裙不允许交踝、支撑不可信；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角
entries.review_note: 既有独立复核：动作几何可参考；不代表全部规格通过。 头手脚完整，但头顶留白目测约3%，未达manifest至少8%；N014、N015的必要竖直支撑面延伸至画幅上边，不等于人台被裁切。 白底、无五官发型文字及服装；延续立体灰面、胸腰塑形偏具体的共同画风差异。 仅取身体关系，不沿用人台体型、画风或边距，不证明商品或身份效果。

entries.title: 背倚单脚点墙
entries.body_action: Place the upper back against a plain vertical wall. The left foot stays on the floor bearing weight; bend the right knee so its sole touches the wall low down. Keep pelvis supported and both hands outside the body.
entries.hands: 双手放在身体外侧，不强制插袋
entries.support: Upper back contacts the wall; left foot planted, right sole touches the wall low down.
entries.avoid_when: 窄裙、鞋底不可见、后片必须展示、衣物易被墙压坏；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 胯侧轻靠台边
entries.body_action: Let the left hip lightly touch a low, narrow ledge. Keep the right leg grounded and the left foot slightly forward. Lift the rib cage and make a small angle between chest and pelvis. Both hands brace lightly on the ledge behind the hips, elbows not locked.
entries.hands: 双手在胯后台边支撑，肘不过度后锁

entries.title: 侧卧前臂支撑
entries.body_action: Lie on the left hip and outer left thigh, legs gently offset with only slight knee bend. Support the raised chest with the left forearm at the side; keep shoulders and pelvis aligned without arching the back.
entries.hands: Left forearm supports the chest from the side; right hand rests outside the upper right thigh.
entries.support: Left hip, outer left thigh and left forearm contact the floor; left forearm supports the raised chest.
entries.avoid_when: 普通结构主图、短裙／低领、童装、床或性感化语境；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 长线侧卧
entries.body_action: Lie in a relaxed long line on the left side. Bend the left forearm near the head and rest the head gently on the left palm. Shift the right leg slightly forward over the lower leg, keeping the spine neutral and the pelvis relaxed.
entries.hands: Left palm gently supports the head; right hand rests along the outer right thigh.
entries.support: Left side rests on the floor; bent left elbow/forearm support the head through the left palm.
entries.avoid_when: 要求完整正面、短裙／透明服饰、童装或暧昧语境；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 双肘展开抱头
entries.body_action: Stand with feet slightly staggered and stable. Lift both arms beside the head with elbows opened outward; keep ribs settled and pelvis neutral. Both hands rest lightly behind the upper head, fingers separate and relaxed.
entries.hands: 双手轻搭后脑上缘，手指不交缠
entries.support: Both feet planted, slightly staggered; no external support.
entries.avoid_when: 紧窄袖、固定肩带、易走光或必须保持衣长平直的商品；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 单手扶后颈
entries.body_action: Put weight mainly on the left rear foot and soften the right knee. Raise the right upper arm with a small shoulder-pelvis offset; the right hand rests at the outer back of the neck while the left arm hangs alongside the leg.
entries.hands: 一手落在后颈外侧，另一手沿腿侧
entries.support: Left rear foot bears weight; right knee soft with light forefoot contact.
entries.avoid_when: 高领／帽领为必须完整展示部位；抬臂严重拉扯；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 无支撑轻前倾
entries.body_action: With both feet grounded and knees soft, hinge a small amount from the hips while lengthening the spine. Keep chest and pelvis facing nearly the same direction. Both arms hang freely outside the thighs; hands do not touch legs or any support.
entries.hands: 双手悬在大腿外侧，不扶腿不撑物
entries.support: Both feet grounded; no hand, thigh or external support.
entries.avoid_when: 低领易走光、硬挺前片必须完整平展；不得改成深鞠躬；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 高台边缘半坐
entries.body_action: Perch with only the left sitting bone supported on a narrow ledge. The right leg reaches down and bears weight through a fully planted foot; the left knee bends naturally; do not require this relaxed foot to bear weight or force both feet into the same planted stance. Keep shoulders open. Both hands brace lightly on the ledge beside the hips; show the contact and grounded foot clearly.
entries.hands: 双手在胯旁台沿轻撑
entries.support: Left sitting bone on a narrow ledge, right foot fully planted; both hands lightly brace on the ledge. The bent left leg is relaxed, not weight-bearing.
entries.avoid_when: 台高不合理、脚悬空、短裙、衣摆主结构被坐压；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角

entries.title: 侧折腿坐地
entries.body_action: Sit on the floor with both legs folded naturally toward the left. Put most weight on the right sitting bone; lengthen the chest upward with a slight chest-pelvis turn. The right palm supports on the floor behind the right hip; the left hand rests lightly outside the left knee.
entries.hands: 一手撑在侧后地面，另一手轻落膝外
entries.support: Right sitting bone and right palm on the floor; folded legs rest on the ground.
entries.avoid_when: 短裙、膝踝扭转不自然、硬挺礼服结构易塌；肩胯仍有轻转，需同款前侧商品依据

entries.title: 一膝着地半跪
entries.body_action: Place the left knee on the floor and the right foot forward, planted flat with knee pointing in the same direction as toes. Keep pelvis level and retain a modest shoulder-pelvis offset. Right hand rests outside the forward thigh; left arm hangs outside the waist.
entries.hands: 一手在前腿外侧，另一手垂于腰外
entries.support: Left knee and instep on the floor; right foot planted forward with knee aligned to toes.
entries.avoid_when: 窄裙、长拖尾、腿部活动量未知；不得当宗教动作默认使用；需同款前侧商品依据，线稿不能补足商品视角
